message.text: Legs: double tap Left Shift to autorun, on land or swimming. Any movement key, Shift, Space, fire, or raising a weapon stops it. Rebind under Controls > NIMBY.
Hands: press O with an item in hands to offer it, or with empty hands to request one; press again to stop. Bind 'open or close pockets' under Controls > NIMBY.
Ears: press N to put earplugs in or take them out. Rebind it under Options > Controls > NIMBY.
Scrawl: hold a pen and drop one sheet on it, or hold the sheet and drop the pen, then hold left mouse to write. Hold left mouse on a note in hands to read.
Tack: pin a note to a wall with a hammer and nail, duct tape, epoxy putty, or a knife. Hold F on a pinned note to read it or take it down.
